content: xUnit v3 4.x: test projects are executables; xunit.v3 4.x uses MTP v2; Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk and xunit.runner.visualstudio optional but recommended for back-compat; enable .NET 10 SDK MTP dotnet test via global.json {"test":{"runner":"Microsoft.Testing.Platform"}}; MTP options like --filter-class pass straight to dotnet test.
